news.analysis: The Bucs managed to win a game where Mayfield did not complete a single pass as they ran for 324 yards as a team. This was the second time a team has completed zero passes in the Super Bowl era and the first time in over 50 years. Mayfield will be a QB2 play next week against the Bears.
news.contents: Baker Mayfield went 0-for-3 in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.title: Baker Mayfield does not complete pass Sunday

news.contents: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield completed zero passes on three attempts in a 16-0 win against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 8. Josh Dubow of the Associated Press reported it was the first time since 1974 that a quarterback completed zero passes in a victory. Tampa Bay running back Bucky Irving scored the team's only touchdown on the day, with kicker Chase McLaughlin adding the remaining points to the scoreboard.
